name: CC-CEDICT
goodFor: An open Chinese-English dictionary of words and characters, with pinyin, for first- and second-year Mandarin.
attribution: "CC-CEDICT" by the CC-CEDICT editors (MDBG), linked to https://cc-cedict.org/wiki/; "CC BY-SA 4.0", linked to https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/; and, when entries shown were shortened or changed, a note that they were.

evidence.quote: CC-CEDICT is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-Share Alike 4.0 License (click the link for detailed information).
CC-CEDICT is a continuation of the CEDICT project.
This WIKI is hosted and maintained by MDBG .

notes: Checked against the project's home page on cc-cedict.org, which states CC BY-SA 4.0 for CC-CEDICT as a whole and links the 4.0 licence deed; no exception or "except where otherwise noted" clause was found there or on the wiki's guidelines, contact and app-developer pages. The app-developer page gives display suggestions only, no further conditions. Share-alike applies to what Ceder shows and to any changes it makes to entries. The wiki is hosted and maintained by MDBG; the download file and MDBG's own site (www.mdbg.net) weren't reachable, so the licence header inside the data file and any MDBG terms weren't read, and the wiki's download page (cc-cedict:download) doesn't exist. No separate terms-of-use page was found on cc-cedict.org. A dictionary only: no lessons or exercises, so it supports a Mandarin course rather than serving as one. The bank's agents don't read it and nothing from it goes into the bank.
